_comment: Onboarding examples (M12 sprint 2, item 3). Each `params` is laid over ConfigPanel's DEFAULTS. Examples of how the tool works, not recommendations: the copy says what to look at, never what to buy. Checked by frontend/src/lib/samples.test.js and backend/tests/test_sample_strategies.py, which runs each one through the API.

samples.title: Trend following on one stock
samples.idea: Momentum on Reliance: hold while the price is rising above its 50-day average, sit in cash otherwise.
samples.look_at: Compare the strategy line with buy-and-hold on the equity chart, then check the drawdown: following a trend often gives up return to avoid the worst falls.

samples.title: Mean reversion on an index fund
samples.idea: Bollinger bands on SPY: buy when the price drops well below its 20-day average, sell when it stretches above.
samples.look_at: Open the Validation tab. A strategy that looks good on one run can fail walk-forward, which is what the tab is for.

samples.title: A small basket with a stop-loss
samples.idea: MACD on three large US stocks, equal weight, with an 8% stop-loss on each position.
samples.look_at: The legs table shows which stock carried the result. Turn the stop off and run again to see what it changed.
